precededByHostDenial.rule: host approval-review denials are recorded in reviewer subagent sessions; each is attributed to its root coordinator session (full IDs) and counted when it precedes the stop within the window. Timing only, not causation.

c2.lowerBound: Extraction starts from user messages; owner-gated commands after the last user message were outside classification. In 3 of the 16 coordinator sessions with in-window user messages, `gh pr merge` or `git push` ran after the last user message (phase0-decisions.mjs terminal candidates), so c2 is a lower bound.
